positiveEvidence.title: HeraRicarica EV Driver Web Portal - Tariffe
positiveEvidence.details: Current first-party tariff page is live. Public server-rendered/indexable surface exposes headings 'Offerta flat' and 'Offerta a consumo' but no energy EUR/kWh values. It does expose current post-charge penalties: EUR 0.08/min after 60 minutes for Type 2/3A from 07:00-23:00, and EUR 0.15/min after 60 minutes for CHAdeMO/CCS2 00:00-23:59.

Current portal defines power filters Default 0-22 kW, Rapido 23-50 kW, Veloce 51-100 kW, Powered 101-150 kW, Ultra >150 kW. These are discovery/mapping classes only; no energy price may be inferred from them.

negativeEvidence: Current first-party tariff page does not expose the energy EUR/kWh component in its public server-rendered/indexable response; generic web/PDF search remains exhausted without a current first-party energy value.
updates.decision: Keep HER fail-closed for ranking. Preserve current first-party penalty and power taxonomy, but do not combine them with mirrored/historical energy values. Next useful route is client-side bundle/API/app payload inspection with deterministic physical-operator/station/EVSE mapping.
updates.resumeCondition: Obtain current first-party energy tariff payload plus deterministic operator/station/EVSE mapping and effective dates.
updates.confidence: high for live penalty/power taxonomy; insufficient for complete current rankable tariff

history: 2026-09-15 run201: rechecked the live first-party HeraRicarica tariff surface; confirmed current penalties and power taxonomy, confirmed energy values remain absent from the public server-rendered/indexable response, and closed generic web/PDF search against repetition.
